title: Relational Recursive CTE Graph Cycle Brakes

claims.assertion: Recursive CTE graph traversal without path tracking loops infinitely on cyclic graphs causing execution timeouts and database crashes.
String concatenation of visited nodes with instr(path, next) cycle detection provides lightweight cycle braking in standard SQL.
Combining cycle detection with hard depth brakes and ROW_NUMBER() window partitioning extracts BFS shortest paths efficiently.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_04: Relational Recursive CTE Graph Cycle Brakes
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Recursive Common Table Expressions (CTEs) traversing relational graphs must accumulate visited path identifiers, prune cyclic loops via `instr(visited_path, next_node) = 0` checks, and enforce hard max depth limits to guarantee bounded execution.
